title: Prove the removal by its invariants, not by the names deleted
action: Create scripts/tests/test_instruction_size_law.mjs. It is auto-discovered under scripts/tests by run_verify.mjs:93-98, so it needs no EXTRA_SUITES entry. This is the slice's one trailing test cell and it asserts NET behavior, not per-cell internals. A removal is verified by its invariants, not the names it deletes (critical pattern 20260711), so scope every assertion to the DEFECT CLASS and never to the two filenames just deleted. Assert (1) no size law on instruction text survives anywhere in scripts/: no HARD_FAIL_BYTES, no WARN_BYTES, no read of a per-skill byte baseline, no comparison of a skills/**/SKILL.md size against a recorded ceiling. Assert (2) the meaning guards STILL BITE -- seed a violation and assert scripts/tests/test_agents_budget.mjs exits non-zero, for the roster guard AND for the byte-identical render guard, because a guard that tests one state is a law with a hole (critical pattern 20260713). MECHANISM, so nothing is guessed: test_agents_budget.mjs:83-84 reads the REAL TEMPLATE_PATH and ROOT_AGENTS_PATH, so NEVER mutate the live AGENTS.md -- that trips the write guard and critical rule 16. Follow the pattern the file already uses at :193-213, where the negative control builds fixture TEXT in memory and runs the assertion helper against it; confirm that control still runs after bfr-2's edit and extend the same in-memory approach to the render guard. DO NOT add an orphan-declaration guard over scripts/verify-cache-inputs.json: no locked decision authorizes new standing coverage and it is already filed to the backlog. DO NOT assert an exact SUITES.length: it would contradict the discovery design at run_verify.mjs:86-88 and duplicate the floor at scripts/tests/test_verify_manifest.mjs:219.
